metadata.title: @capgo/capacitor-native-biometric
metadata.description: Secure credential storage and biometric-gated access for Android and iOS.

hero.tagline: Secure credential storage and biometric-gated access for Android and iOS.

blocks.text: Native Biometric is a secure credential vault for iOS and Android. It stores credentials in the native Keychain or Keystore and can require biometric authentication before sensitive values are returned. It is a direct replacement for Ionic Identity Vault credential-vault flows; your app keeps control of timeout, lifecycle, privacy-screen, and custom-passcode policies.
- Securely store and retrieve credentials for a given server.
- Read credentials only after a native biometric check.
- Build onboarding, locked-state, and logout flows.
- Check authentication availability and prompt the user when needed.
Checks if biometric authentication hardware is available.

Adds a listener that is called when the app resumes from background. This is useful to detect if biometry availability has changed while the app was in the background (e.g., user enrolled/unenrolled biometrics).
Prompts the user to authenticate with biometrics.
Gets the stored credentials for a given server.
Stores the given credentials for a given server.
Deletes the stored credentials for a given server.
Gets the stored credentials for a given server, requiring biometric authentication. Credentials must have been stored with accessControl set to BIOMETRY_CURRENT_SET or BIOMETRY_ANY.
Checks if credentials are already saved for a given server.
